description: On-page SEO audit of one URL with a 0-100 score, letter grade and prioritised issues (high/medium/low): title and meta description length, robots meta and X-Robots-Tag noindex, canonical, lang, viewport, charset, favicon, H1/heading outline, image alt coverage, internal/external/nofollow links, OpenGraph and Twitter cards, JSON-LD/microdata types, hreflang, mixed content, word count, plus robots.txt allow/deny for the URL and declared sitemaps. SSRF-safe fetching. Price: $0.01 USDC per successful call (x402, Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: GET https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/seo-audit

robots.description: Also fetch robots.txt and test the URL against it (default true)
